name: Icicle Swarm

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

resistances.name: Melee and Ranged
resistances.details: Half damage from melee and ranged attacks

sourceBooks: Monster Vault: Threats to the Nentir Vale
description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Swarm Attack
traits.details: Any enemy that ends its turn in the aura takes 5 cold damage.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.details: The swarm can occupy the same space as another creature, and an enemy can enter its space, which is difficult terrain. The swarm cannot be pulled, pushed, or slid by melee or ranged attacks. It can squeeze through any opening that is large enough for a Tiny creature.

auras.name: Swarm Attack
auras.details: Any enemy that ends its turn in the aura takes 5 cold damage.

hit.description: cold damage. On a critical hit, the target is immobilized (save ends).

effect.description: Before or after the attack, the swarm can shift up to 2 squares.
